rules: Never use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Storefront: Emphasize elegance and quiet luxury with Cormorant Garamond.
Admin: Clean, high-legibility with Manrope and IBM Plex Sans.
Storefront: Pastel minimal. Never use highly saturated colors. Use stone, sand, sage, bone.
Admin: High contrast, neutral palette. Color is used strictly for state and hierarchy.
Never use pure black (#000000) or pure gray (#808080). Tint neutrals warmly.
Ensure APCA/WCAG contrast ratios are met.

storefront.spacing: Generous. Use p-8, p-12, p-16 for containers. Whitespace is a luxury indicator.
storefront.grid: Bento/Tetris Grid. Asymmetric alignments. Avoid perfectly uniform grids.
storefront.hero: Full-bleed imagery with minimal text. Let the apparel shine.

admin.spacing: Dense but legible. p-4 to p-6.
admin.surface: Flat solid surfaces with subtle 1px border. No heavy drop shadows.

rules: Always mobile-first. App must be a fully responsive PWA.

storefront.strategy: Custom HTML/Tailwind for layouts, heavily customized Shadcn for forms/drawers.
storefront.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp minimal. Soft transitions.
storefront.cards: Cardless look for products. Just image and minimalist text beneath.
storefront.pdp: Immersive image/video gallery, clear variant selector (size/color), elegant reviews.

admin.strategy: Extensive use of Shadcn components (Tables, Dialogs, Select, Dropdowns).
admin.cards: Subtle border, no shadow unless hovered.
admin.views: Order timeline view, drag-drop media library, KPI cards.

visual_enhancers.storefront: Subtle noise texture on backgrounds. Crystal Glassmorphism for sticky headers (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/40).
visual_enhancers.admin: Technical minimal. Subtle inner shadows for active states.
visual_enhancers.motion: Lenis for smooth scrolling on Storefront. Framer Motion for page transitions, slow pan on product images, and staggered fade-ins.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text. APCA preferred.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='pdp-add-to-cart-button').

roles_and_auth: Ensure distinct user flows and UI capabilities for roles: Owner, Manager, Support, Fulfillment.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building 'Loom & Pastel Co.', a mid-premium women's fusion wear D2C brand.
Split the frontend into two distinctive but cohesive areas: Storefront (Modern Minimal Luxury) and Admin Dashboard (Clean, Dense Utility).
Storefront must prioritize imagery over UI elements. Avoid heavy card borders; use whitespace to frame products.
Do not use generic font pairs like Inter or Roboto. Use Cormorant Garamond and Outfit for Storefront, Manrope and IBM Plex Sans for Admin.
For components: Utilize Shadcn UI heavily for Admin. For Storefront, use raw HTML/Tailwind for layout to ensure high-end asymmetrical design, while embedding customized Shadcn for forms/inputs.
Apply Framer Motion for subtle entry animations and micro-interactions.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on sticky headers or overlays. Use backdrop-blur combined with semi-transparent colors.
CRITICAL: The codebase uses .js/.jsx, NOT .tsx. All your components and instructions must be React JS, not TypeScript.
PWA installable: Setup manifests, service workers for offline-capability and installability.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Break away from centered, uniform layouts.
Avoid simplistic gradients. Use solid colors or very subtle noise textures.
NEVER use generic emoji characters for icons. Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for high-end feel.
Apply hover/active/focus states consistently across the app.
Do not globally apply 'transition: all' in CSS.
Utilize Sonner for all toast notifications.
Never use placeholder image URLs like via.placeholder.com. ONLY use the provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs in the design guidelines.
